name: codex-plugin
description: Open a local PDF in Placekeeper and keep its content and annotations current in the hosting Codex task.

interface.shortDescription: Review a local PDF with live task context.
interface.longDescription: Launches one explicitly referenced local PDF in the native Codex panel and uses trusted lifecycle hooks to provide task-scoped PDF and annotation context on every prompt.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open this local PDF in Placekeeper with $placekeeper.
